_comment: dose-cite-v1 fixtures: reply text + a named source set -> the expected verdict fields. The canonical rule is src/triage/lookup-guard.js; the triage repo's probes/dose-cite.mjs vendors it and asserts identity over these files. WITHHELD stands for lookup-guard.js's WITHHELD_BANNER and NO_EVIDENCE for LOOKUP_NO_EVIDENCE_TEXT.

cases.name: a cited dose present in the cited source is kept
cases.replyText: Paracetamol is a painkiller [2]. The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours [1].

expected.displayText: Paracetamol is a painkiller [2]. The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours [1].

cases.name: unit spelling and spacing are normalised before the verbatim check
cases.replyText: Adults usually take 500 mg three times daily [1].

expected.displayText: Adults usually take 500 mg three times daily [1].

cases.name: a frequency range with an en dash matches the source's written range
cases.replyText: Take 1-2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours when needed [1].

expected.displayText: Take 1-2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours when needed [1].

cases.name: a dose with no citation is withheld, the rest is kept
cases.replyText: Paracetamol treats aches and pains [2]. Adults can take 1000 mg at a time.

expected.displayText: Paracetamol treats aches and pains [2]. WITHHELD

withheld.sentence: Adults can take 1000 mg at a time.

cases.name: a cited dose absent from the cited source is withheld
cases.replyText: Paracetamol treats aches and pains [2]. The usual dose is 650mg every 6 hours [1].

expected.displayText: Paracetamol treats aches and pains [2]. WITHHELD

withheld.sentence: The usual dose is 650mg every 6 hours [1].

cases.name: a dose cited to a source that does not state it is withheld even when another source does
cases.replyText: Paracetamol reduces a high temperature [2]. Take 500mg tablets [2].

expected.displayText: Paracetamol reduces a high temperature [2]. WITHHELD

cases.name: mg is not mg/kg: a per-kilogram dose does not match a flat dose
a citation out of range withholds its sentence
cases.replyText: Paracetamol is a common painkiller [2]. It is safe in pregnancy [7].

expected.displayText: Paracetamol is a common painkiller [2]. WITHHELD

cases.name: a citation range form the rule does not parse is withheld
a sentence citing an overdose section is withheld even with a verbatim dose
cases.replyText: The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours [1]. Go to A&E if you take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours [3].

expected.displayText: The usual dose is one or two 500mg tablets up to 4 times in 24 hours [1]. WITHHELD

withheld.sentence: Go to A&E if you take more than 8 tablets in 24 hours [3].

cases.name: a maximum-dose section is withheld too
cases.replyText: Never take more than 8 puffs in 24 hours [2].

withheld.sentence: Never take more than 8 puffs in 24 hours [2].

cases.name: consecutive withheld sentences collapse into one banner
cases.replyText: Paracetamol is a painkiller [2]. Take 1g. Then take 1g again [9]. It also lowers a high temperature [2].

expected.displayText: Paracetamol is a painkiller [2]. WITHHELD It also lowers a high temperature [2].

cases.name: a citation after the full stop belongs to the sentence before it
cases.replyText:
Leave at least 4 hours between doses. [1]
Paracetamol is a painkiller. [2]

expected.displayText:
Leave at least 4 hours between doses. [1]
Paracetamol is a painkiller. [2]

cases.name: a decimal point does not end a sentence
a reply with nothing citable left is the scripted no-evidence refusal
cases.replyText: I could not find that in the sources.

cases.name: an empty reply is the scripted no-evidence refusal
